title: Tree Guide Lines Emphasize On Hover
description: Tree indentation guide lines should turn emphasized when hovering over a tree item row.
summary: Tree indentation guide lines, branch elbows, and stems now emphasize on row hover. Added treeGuideLineStrokeClassName with group-hover:bg-emphasized on gutter strokes; updated TreeHoverPath CSS to use --border-emphasized-color (replacing muted mix), added stem emphasis, and :has() fallback for branch guide lines in all tree variants.
